---
name: Rubric proposal
about: Argue with a weight, hard fail, or slop-trope deduction
title: "[rubric] "
labels: rubric
---

**Which rule**
The dimension weight, hard-fail cap, or slop-trope deduction you want to change (cite the line
in `rubric.md`).

**Change you propose**
e.g. "Originality weight 20 → 25" or "add <X> as a slop trope".

**Why**
Make the case. Examples / screenshots of pages that are currently mis-scored help a lot.

**Score impact**
If you can, note how this changes the score on the `examples/` pages.
